title: Who handles the sweater party better?
old_caption:
Sweater party: tasteful grey with one stripe, or a sweater that lights up and beeps?
Wear whatever makes you grin.

title: Who handles a small disagreement better?
old_caption:
Small disagreement. Fix it this second, or agree with every side, even the lamp's?
Pause, breathe, then come back and talk.

title: Who handles a change of plans better?
old_caption:
The plan was pasta. Now the plan is changing. Is that you?
Feeling thrown is fine. Say so, then roll with it.

title: Who packs for a holiday trip better?
old_caption:
Holiday trip: packed in five minutes with no socks, or a week early with seven pairs?
Pack light and share the socks.

title: Who handles meeting their pet better?
old_caption:
Meeting their pet for the first time: a hand-knitted sweater, or straight to fetch?
Kindness to what they love says a lot.

title: Who handles the holiday photo better?
old_caption:
Holiday photos: twelve more for your good side, or crying at how cute it came out?
Get in the picture. You'll be glad later.

title: Who handles the countdown better?
old_caption:
The countdown to midnight: run it to the second, or make a quiet wish together?
Whatever the clock says, be with your people.

title: Leo × Capricorn: the spotlight and the schedule.
old_caption: Wanting to be seen and wanting to be home by nine can share one night. Say the compliment out loud, respect each other's limits, and give the spotlight a time slot.

title: Gemini × Cancer: the plans and the soup.
old_caption: Big plans and a quiet night in don't have to compete. Ask one question and hear the whole answer, and say "I miss you" instead of hinting it. Save this for your next cozy weekend.

title: Taurus × Aquarius: the usual and the unusual.
old_caption: Loving the familiar isn't boring, and loving the new isn't flaky. Keep one ritual, try one new thing, then make a tradition that belongs to just the two of you.
